intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Bengaluru. This page compares recorded fees and placements from our database opened in {{year}}, and flags a placement year that is too old to treat as current.

St Joseph's College of Commerce vs The Oxford College of Business Management is a same-city comparison. Oxford has the only 2020 or later placement record on this page, from 2023. St Joseph's latest recorded year here is 2019.

sections.heading: St Joseph's College of Commerce vs The Oxford College of Business Management for B.Com: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose St Joseph's College of Commerce if you want a well-known Bengaluru commerce college and have confirmed its official fee. Our records list an academic charge of ₹1.07 lakh a year, but the latest placement year here is 2019.
Choose The Oxford College of Business Management if you want a recorded 2023 year, at an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh, and recorded tuition of ₹50,000 a year.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: St Joseph's College of Commerce has a recorded academic fee of ₹1.07 lakh a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed three-year total, until you check the official circular.
The Oxford College of Business Management has recorded tuition of ₹50,000 a year. Confirm both official notices for the current admission year.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Oxford's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹5 lakh and a highest package of ₹10 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

St Joseph's latest recorded year here is 2019, with an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹14 lakh. Because 2019 is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result. Ask the college for its latest official report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Many Bengaluru B.Com admissions are based on Class 12 marks, sometimes with a college-level process.
Read the current official admissions page of each college for eligibility and any test or interview.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Bengaluru, Karnataka, on different sites. St Joseph's College of Commerce is a long-established city campus. Oxford is a separate Bengaluru business-management campus.
Visit both if commute and classroom size will decide the choice.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a 2023 placement record and a lower recorded year fee, Oxford is the side we can quote, at ₹50,000 tuition and a ₹5 lakh average.
If you want St Joseph's College of Commerce, confirm its official fee and ask for a current placement report, because this page only holds a 2019 row.
Do not compare a 2019 package with a 2023 package as if they described the same year.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, St Joseph's College of Commerce or The Oxford College of Business Management?
faqs.answer: Oxford has the only 2020 or later placement record on this page, from 2023, with a ₹5 lakh average and a ₹10 lakh highest package, and recorded tuition of ₹50,000 a year. St Joseph's has a recorded academic fee of ₹1.07 lakh a year and a 2019 placement row, which we do not treat as current.

faqs.question: Do these colleges have an entrance exam for B.Com?
faqs.answer: No exam is listed for either side in our records on this page. Check each official admissions page.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: Oxford's recorded 2023 average is ₹5 lakh and the highest is ₹10 lakh. St Joseph's latest recorded year here is 2019, which this page does not treat as a current flagship result.

faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Bengaluru, Karnataka, on different campuses.
